verdict.rationale: Codegen documents two-way conversation with agents. Agents can ask for clarification and users can communicate with them directly in Slack, and the API can resume a paused agent run so it continues processing. This implies mid-session steering, but nothing explicitly documents sending a follow-up instruction into an already-running session without starting a new run. Missing for 10: an explicit documented follow-up/message-to-active-run capability (API, SDK or UI), confirmation that the resume endpoint accepts new instructions, and hands-on corroboration of steering without restart.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting

citations.quote: Add the Codegen Slack App to communicate with the agent directly in your workspace.
Send notifications, ask for clarification, report progress, and interact directly with your team in Slack channels.
Resumes a paused agent run, allowing it to continue processing.
